name: Place search returns selectable, fully visible results
description: Searching a public clinic lists results that are readable and selectable.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Type 'Mayo Clinic Rochester' in 'Find a public clinic or pharmacy' and click 'Search places'
Verify 'Mayo Clinic Saint Marys Campus' appears in the results
Verify every listed result, including the last one, is fully visible and not covered by a footer or other fixed element
Verify the text 'Location selected.' is shown and 'Confirmed address' contains '1216 2nd Street Southwest'
